Since the rebranding of the **[European Champion Clubs' Cup](UEFA_Champions_League "UEFA Champions League")** to **[UEFA Champions League](UEFA_Champions_League "UEFA Champions League")** in 1992 at the start of the [1992–93 season](1992%E2%80%9393_UEFA_Champions_League "1992–93 UEFA Champions League"), a total of 47 players have managed to make at least 100 appearances in the competition.[[1]](List_of_footballers_with_100_or_more_UEFA_Champions_League_appearances#cite_note-100Games-1) The first player to hit the landmark was [Raúl](Ra%C3%BAl_(footballer) "Raúl (footballer)"), who did so in February 2006,[[2]](List_of_footballers_with_100_or_more_UEFA_Champions_League_appearances#cite_note-2) while the most recent member of the "100 club" is [Thiago Silva](Thiago_Silva "Thiago Silva"), who played his 100th match in October 2022.[[1]](List_of_footballers_with_100_or_more_UEFA_Champions_League_appearances#cite_note-100Games-1) The player with the most appearances is [Cristiano Ronaldo](Cristiano_Ronaldo "Cristiano Ronaldo"), who has played 183 matches in the Champions League.[[3]](List_of_footballers_with_100_or_more_UEFA_Champions_League_appearances#cite_note-3)
